stats.done_summary: Successfully implemented and applied the Temporal Stability Index (TSI) to industrial control telemetry data. The analysis of 5,000 frames yielded a TSI value of 0.9684, indicating high temporal stability in the model output signal. Key findings: (1) σ_x = 2.533 (population std of model output), (2) σ_d = 0.080 (population std of first differences), (3) the ratio σ_d/(σ_x+ε) = 0.0316, confirming that consecutive values change very little relative to overall signal variability. All deliverables completed: analysis code, intermediate results, comprehensive report with 5 visualization figures.
